title: Agent harness construction
summary: Design an agent's tool surface, step budget and output contract so a small model can use it reliably, with every capability granted by code and observable in traces.

provenance.notes: Adds this project's constraint that local models have small context windows, so tool count and schema size are budgeted.

inputs.name: agent
inputs.description: The agent definition and its tools.

inputs.name: model-limits
inputs.description: Context window and tool-calling reliability of the target model.

outputs.name: assessment
outputs.description: Tool surface, budget and contract findings.

workflow.step: List each tool with its permission class (read, write, execute) and justify why the role needs it.
workflow.check: No tool is present only because it is convenient.

workflow.step: Confirm permissions are enforced by code at the tool, not by the agent's instructions.
workflow.check: A model that ignores its instructions still cannot exceed its role.

workflow.step: Measure the prompt cost of instructions plus tool schemas against the model's context window.
workflow.check: The budget leaves room for repository content.

workflow.step: Check the output contract is a strict schema with a size limit and an explicit unknown/insufficient-evidence state.
workflow.check: Free-form prose is not parsed for decisions.

workflow.step: Check traces: each tool call, step and error is visible per agent and correlated to the workflow run.

constraints: Registering an agent must not call a model or mutate a repository.
No specialist role gains write access automatically.

examples.title: Convenience shell tool
examples.situation: A reviewer is given a shell tool to run tests.
examples.guidance: Remove it; read-only reviewers get inspection tools, and verification stays with the runtime verifier.

verification: Every tool has a class and a reason.
Prompt cost is stated in bytes or tokens.

task.text: Review the agent harness tool schema and the tool permissions for the Mastra agent.
Design the step budget and output contract for the new agent tools.
